# Marco Soprani Tayar

> Marco Soprani Tayar, also known as Marco Tayar, works on physical AI and aerial robotics: training and deploying models for robot perception, navigation, and control.

Mechatronics Engineering student at EESC, University of São Paulo, and researcher at the USP Center for Robotics. Research includes reinforcement learning in simulation, onboard vision-language navigation, learned perception, and embedded deployment. RAPTOR work is integration and deployment of a pretrained policy, not training that policy. VLN flight experiments used motion-capture localization.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio, projects, publications, and experience](https://marcotayar.com/): Primary source for current public information.
- [CV](https://marcotayar.com/assets/marco-tayar-cv.pdf): Research and professional background.

## Publications

- [VLN on the Fly](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20191): An Onboard Vision-Language Navigation Stack for Aerial Robots, IMAV 2026.
- [VLN project and demonstrations](https://vln-on-the-fly.github.io/)
- [VLN source code](https://github.com/peDrontonio/VLNontheFly)
- [Autonomous UAV Flight Navigation in Confined Spaces: A Reinforcement Learning Approach](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11273007/): LARS 2025, comparing PPO and SAC in high-fidelity simulation.
